note: Annotation table for the treatment-attribution gold set. Text is NOT stored here; the builder (scripts/nv-build-attribution-goldset.mjs) splices verbatim corpus windows in and fails if an evidence slice is absent, so a label can never drift away from the text it claims to describe.

annotations.target: Siddharam Satlingappa Mhetre v. State of Maharashtra
annotations.evidence: The observations in Siddharam Satlingappa Mhetre v. State of Maharashtra & Ors
annotations.note: Constitution Bench operative conclusion (12). Names the authority in full, then the verb.

annotations.target: Salauddin Abdulsamad Shaikh v. State of Maharashtra
annotations.evidence: the decision in Salauddin Abdulsamad Shaikh v. State of Maharashtra
annotations.note: Same conclusion, second limb: 'are hereby overruled' after a long intervening clause.

annotations.target: Gurbaksh Singh Sibbia v. State of Punjab
annotations.evidence: Shri Gurbaksh Singh Sibbia and others v. State of Punjab (1980) 2 SCC 565 : [1980] 3 SCR 383 – relied on.
annotations.note: THE decisive negative control. Sibbia is RELIED ON in the same reporter block that lists nine authorities as overruled. Proximity matching flags it; the platform must not.

annotations.target: Gurbaksh Singh Sibbia v. State of Punjab
annotations.evidence: the conclusions in Shri Gurbaksh Singh Sibbia and others v. State of Punjab 1980 (2) SCC 565 needs reiteration
annotations.note: Sibbia named, then 'Salauddin ... needs to be overruled' one clause later. A paragraph-scoped binder attributes the verb to Sibbia.

annotations.target: Balchand Jain v. State of Madhya Pradesh
annotations.evidence: the provisions of Section 438 relating to antici~ patory bail stand overruled or repealed by virtue of Rule 184
annotations.note: 'stand overruled' with a STATUTE as its object, inside a sentence whose nearest case name is Balchand Jain. No case was overruled at all.

annotations.target: Balchand Jain v. State of Madhya Pradesh
annotations.evidence: the provisions of Section 438 relating to anticipatory bail stand overruled and repealed by virtue of Rule 184
annotations.note: Second occurrence in Sibbia, this time explicitly reporting what Fazal Ali J. framed as the only point in Balchand Jain.

annotations.target: Union of India v. Azadi Bachao Andolan
annotations.evidence: it was contended on behalf of the Revenue that Union of India v. Azadi Bachao Ando/an (2004) 10 SCC D 1 needs to be overruled
annotations.note: Counsel's prayer, named authority, verb present. Vodafone did not overrule Azadi Bachao. The most dangerous shape in the corpus.

annotations.target: Salauddin Abdulsamad Shaikh v. State of Maharashtra
annotations.evidence: the two-Judge Bench in Mhetre(supra) has taken the stand that the decisions in Salauddin (supra), K.L .Verma (supra), Adri Dharan Das (supra) and Sunita Devi (supra) are per incuriam
annotations.note: The 2018 order REPORTS Mhetre's holding and then refers the question to a larger Bench. It performs no treatment itself.

annotations.target: K.L. Verma v. State
annotations.evidence: The view regarding extension of time to “move” the higher court as culled out from the decision in K.L. Verma case shall have to be treated as having been rendered per incuriam
annotations.note: Inside a block quotation of an earlier judgment ('To quote:'). The 2018 Bench is transcribing, not holding.

annotations.target: Azeez Basha
annotations.evidence: The view taken in Azeez Basha that an educational institution is not established by a minority if it derives its legal character through a statute, is overruled.
annotations.note: Majority holding, 'The view taken in X ... is overruled' — the canonical Indian object-binding form.

annotations.target: Azeez Basha
annotations.evidence: demands due deference rather than the view being overruled at this distance of time
annotations.note: Dipankar Datta J. DECLINING to overrule. 'being overruled' present verbatim; the holding is the opposite.

annotations.target: State of Kerala v. Very Rev. Mother Provincial
annotations.evidence: all the precedents referred to above would stand overruled
annotations.note: Conditional ('If, indeed, the proposed view ... were accepted'), and the object is an unnamed set of precedents.

annotations.target: Pune Municipal Corpn. v. Harakchand Misirimal Solanki
annotations.evidence: the decision rendered in Pune Municipal Corpn.
annotations.note: A 2025 judgment quoting paras 365-367 of Indore Development Authority ('are extracted as under'). The overruling was performed by Indore, not here.

annotations.target: L.G. Chaudhary
annotations.evidence: it cannot be termed to be per incuriam
annotations.note: Explicit negation of a per incuriam finding. Detection-only reports per_incuriam here.

annotations.target: Va Tech Escher Wyass Flovel Ltd. v. M.P. SEB
annotations.evidence: The relevant para 42 reads as under
annotations.note: Block quotation of L.G. Chaudhary's holding that Va Tech is per incuriam. The quoting judgment performs nothing.

annotations.target: SBP & Co. v. Patel Engg. Ltd.
annotations.evidence: the 2015 Amendment Act has legislatively overruled the dictum of Patel Engg.
annotations.note: Legislative supersession, not a judicial treatment edge. Also the exact case a citation graph structurally cannot see.

annotations.target: Hyder Consulting (UK) Ltd.
annotations.evidence: the judgment in S.L. Arora (supra) has since been overruled by a three-Judge Bench of this Court in Hyder Consulting (UK) Ltd. (supra)
annotations.note: Hyder Consulting is the OVERRULING court. Naive matching inverts the edge and reports Hyder as overruled.

annotations.target: Pulukuri Kottaya
annotations.evidence: the decision in Pulukuri Kottaya5 , of the Privy Council, affirmed and reaffirmed by the Supreme Court of India, in which, the Full Bench decision of the Madras High Court in Athappa Goundan12, relied on in the impugned judgment, had been overruled
annotations.note: Pulukuri Kottaya is affirmed; Athappa Goundan is what was overruled. Nearest-name binding gets this backwards.

annotations.target: Kamal K. Singh v. Dinesh Gupta
annotations.evidence: Kamal K. Singh v. Dinesh Gupta (2022) 8 SCC 33; Ashok G. Rajani v. Beacon Trusteeship Ltd [2022] 18 SCR 133 : 2022 SCC OnLine SC 1275 – held per incuriam.
annotations.note: Reporter verdict list, adverse. per incuriam is treated as overruled for good-law purposes.

annotations.target: Swiss Ribbons (P) Ltd. v. Union of India
annotations.evidence: Swiss Ribbons (P) Ltd. v. Union of India [2019] 3 SCR 535 : (2019) 4 SCC 17 – relied on.
annotations.note: Relied on, two lines below a 'held per incuriam' marker in the same block.

annotations.target: Abhishek Singh v. Huhtamaki PPL Limited
annotations.evidence: Abhishek Singh v. Huhtamaki PPL Limited [2023] 4 SCR 596 : 2023 SCC Online SC 349 – distinguished.
annotations.note: Distinguished is neutral. It sits between an adverse marker and a favourable one.

annotations.target: Celir LLP v. Sumati Prasad Bafna
annotations.evidence: He submitted that in the said decision
annotations.note: Counsel recounting what an earlier order did ('overruled the impugned order of the High Court'). The object is an order, not a reported authority, and the frame is a submission.

annotations.target: Siddharam Satlingappa Mhetre v. State of Maharashtra
annotations.evidence: submitted that the decision in Mhetre (supra) is erroneous and should be overruled
annotations.note: Same judgment, same authority, but this passage is the Solicitor General's submission. Mhetre IS overruled later — so an honest harness must score THIS passage as no-finding while scoring window 29 as a finding. Tests that the veto is passage-local, not authority-global.

annotations.target: Salauddin Abdulsamad Shaikh v. State of Maharashtra
annotations.evidence: It is submitted that the decision of this Court in Salauddin Abdulsamad Shaikh (supra) and subsequent judgments following Salauddin Abdulsamad Shaikh (supra) are all per incuriam
annotations.note: Counsel's per incuriam submission, recorded verbatim by the Court.

annotations.target: Gurbaksh Singh Sibbia v. State of Punjab
annotations.evidence: While considering the issues referred to a larger Bench, referred to hereinabove, the decision of the Constitution Bench of this Court in Gurbaksh Singh Sibbia (supra) is required to be referred to and considered in detail
annotations.note: 'referred to a larger Bench' is a DOUBTED phrase, and Sibbia is the nearest name. But the reference concerns the issues, not Sibbia's correctness — Sibbia is being applied.

annotations.target: Central Board of Dawoodi Bohra Community v. State of Maharashtra
annotations.evidence: The position of law laid down in Central Board of Dawoodi Bohra Community is correct
annotations.note: 'requires reconsideration' appears in the same window as an abstract statement of doctrine; Dawoodi Bohra is affirmed as correct.

annotations.target: Azeez Basha
annotations.evidence: Doubting the correctness of the opinion in Azeez Basha, without disagreeing with it
annotations.note: A genuine doubted finding bound to the named authority. Doubt must not escalate to overruled.

annotations.target: Anjuman-e-Rahmaniya
annotations.evidence: the reference by a two-judge bench in Anjuman doubting the correctness of the five-judge bench in Azeez Basha
annotations.note: Anjuman is the DOUBTING bench, not the doubted authority. Inverted-edge control for the doubted verb.

annotations.target: Sree Balaji Nagar Residential Assn. v. State of T.N.
annotations.evidence: The decision in Sree Balaji Nagar Residential Assn.
annotations.note: Named and genuinely overruled — but by Indore Development Authority, in text this 2025 judgment is quoting. The edge belongs to Indore.

annotations.target: MSP Infrastructure Ltd. v. M.P. Road Development Corp. Ltd.
annotations.evidence: in Lion Engg. Consultants Vs. State of M.P. partly overruled MSP Infrastructure Ltd
annotations.note: Reported inside a High Court judgment being recounted, and it is a PARTIAL overruling. Partial overruling is not boolean, which is one reason goodLaw 'good' cannot be asserted.

annotations.target: Henderson v. Henderson
annotations.evidence: Later decisions have doubted the correctness of treating the principle as an application of the doctrine of res judicata
annotations.note: 'doubted the correctness' whose object is a DOCTRINE, inside a quotation from an English authority. No named Indian authority is doubted.

annotations.target: Ashok G. Rajani v. Beacon Trusteeship Ltd
annotations.evidence: The same infirmity is found in Ashok G. Rajani (supra)
annotations.note: Prose per incuriam holding. The judgment's own finding, in its own voice ('In our view ... it would be per incuriam').
